============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 479 ns | 2,086,191 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,871 ns | 205,302 | 365 | 10.17x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 12,113 ns | 82,553 | 365 | 25.29x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 505 ns | 1,980,236 | 341 | 1.05x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 98,306 ns | 10,172 | 341 | 205.23x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,419 ns | 704,529 | 803 | 2.96x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 1,472 ns | 679,127 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 17,187 ns | 58,182 | 11.68x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 26,432 ns | 37,833 | 17.96x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 4,249 ns | 235,360 | 2.89x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 50,219 ns | 19,913 | 34.12x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,329 ns | 231,018 | 2.94x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

| OmniBuf (Generated) | 6,002 ns | 166,616 | 31.93x slower |

| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 47,805 ns | 20,918 | 254.28x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 3,955 ns | 252,841 | 21.04x slower |

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 1,077 ns | 928,877 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 8,813 ns | 113,467 | 39255 | 8.18x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 19,076 ns | 52,421 | 39255 | 17.71x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 2,133 ns | 468,835 | 39227 | 1.98x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,165,340 ns | 858 | 39227 | 1082.02x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 23,605 ns | 42,363 | 39681 | 21.92x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 2,051 ns | 487,622 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 10,697 ns | 93,483 | 5.22x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 6,374 ns | 156,883 | 3.11x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,139,967 ns | 877 | 555.81x slower |
